ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 4 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Ulysses S. Grant

code.originalText: Primary care visit after staging to coordinate nutrition, dental care, tobacco cessation, and symptom control before treatment

text.paragraph: Pre-treatment primary care review after staging. [S]

Mr. Grant returns after staging. The final pathology confirmed p16-negative squamous cell carcinoma of the right tonsillar pillar, and last week's PET/CT showed no distant spread. The head and neck oncology team has recommended chemoradiation, to start in about ten days. The cold he had last week has cleared, apart from a light cough in the mornings. His throat pain is 4 of 10, down from 6 while he was coughing. He weighs 75.5 kg, 2.5 kg below his weight at intake. He saw the dietitian last week and takes soft, calorie-dense foods with two supplement drinks a day. He has smoked no cigars for three weeks and takes varenicline 1 mg twice daily after meals without nausea or changes in mood or sleep. He worries about money and about finishing his memoir during treatment, but still enjoys his writing and his visitors. He has not yet seen a dentist. [S]
